title: Data Workbench On-Demand Provider Resolution
category: Professional SaaS / provider coverage / derived intelligence
summary: Turns Data Workbench hydration into an explicit on-demand provider resolver. Selected fields are checked against plan governance, the Watchdog property warehouse, NJOGIS Parcels/MOD-IV, trusted Watchdog observations and user-scoped derived-value cache. Canonical deterministic property metrics and Chapter 123 screening values are calculated on demand when source facts support them, cached for reuse, and returned with provider/source/status metadata. Unsupported catalog fields are now distinguished from trusted scores that simply have not yet been computed.

items.detail: workbench-hydrate v5 classifies each requested property/marker value as authoritative source data, trusted Watchdog observation, cached value, deterministic derived metric, Chapter 123 derived metric, not yet computed, provider missing or not entitled.

Canonical existing formulas now resolve building age, years since last sale, tax-to-assessment rate, land share, improvement share, assessment per acre and lot-area square footage whenever those fields are selected.

The Workbench reuses the production farm-intelligence Chapter 123 methodology, including nominal/token sale rejection and plausible assessment-to-sale screening, to resolve ratio, upper-limit, supported assessment, estimated reduction, annual tax difference and percent-above-upper-limit fields on demand.

Watchdog Score, Tax Pressure, Revaluation Risk and Uniformity remain sourced only from trusted score observations. If no trusted observation exists the resolver reports Not yet computed instead of inventing a replacement formula.
Derived values are persisted to the existing user-scoped bulk_metric_cache and every resolved cell receives source/observation metadata for UI provenance and future freshness handling.
Expanded data_center_provider_coverage from the original core field set to record the live Workbench resolver, canonical derived providers, Chapter 123 provider and partial trusted-score coverage.

Added a provider-status client layer that distinguishes resolved values, trusted scores awaiting computation, provider gaps and entitlement blocks, with source/checked-time details available on cell hover.
No new proprietary score formulas were invented. Fields without a connected provider remain explicitly identified as provider gaps so provider coverage can be expanded systematically.
